dedupe_keys.name: collision avoidance strategy for autonomous intersection management by a central optimizer algorithm

description: The model combines a central optimiser and local connected-vehicle controllers. It assigns waiting times at waypoints for simultaneous intersection crossing and uses lower-level controllers to regulate speed. The source reports MATLAB simulation to assess the method. This is a documented intersection-control model; collision-free behaviour is a source-defined simulation objective, not an unconditional operational safety guarantee. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
